svg.title: Detection rules mapped to ATT&CK, in numbers
svg.desc: Dashboard: 172 detection rules in the registry, 140 carrying at least one technique, 32 deliberately mapped to nothing, 30 distinct techniques and sub-techniques reached, 9 tactics reached, and 195 rule to technique placements: 65 direct, 69 partial, 61 context. Same figures as the table below.
